verses.original: וַיְהִ֣י כִשְׁמֹ֣עַ כָּל־ מַלְכֵ֣י הָאֱמֹרִ֡י אֲשֶׁר֩ בְּעֵ֨בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֜ן יָ֗מָּה וְכָל־ מַלְכֵ֤י הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עַל־ הַיָּ֔ם אֵ֠ת אֲשֶׁר־ הוֹבִ֨ישׁ יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־ מֵ֧י הַיַּרְדֵּ֛ן מִפְּנֵ֥י בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל עַד־ עָבְרָנוּ וַיִּמַּ֣ס לְבָבָ֗ם וְלֹא־ הָ֨יָה בָ֥ם עוֹד֙ ר֔וּחַ מִפְּנֵ֖י בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·hî ḵiš·mō·a‘ kāl- mal·ḵê hā·’ĕ·mō·rî ’ă·šer bə·‘ê·ḇer hay·yar·dên yām·māh wə·ḵāl mal·ḵê hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî ’ă·šer ‘al- hay·yām ’êṯ ’ă·šer- hō·w·ḇîš Yah·weh ’eṯ- mê hay·yar·dên mip·pə·nê ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ‘aḏ- ʿå̄·ḇə·rå̄·nū way·yim·mas lə·ḇā·ḇām wə·lō- hā·yāh ḇām ‘ō·wḏ rū·aḥ mip·pə·nê bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Now when all the Amorite kings west of the Jordan and all the Canaanite kings along the coast heard how the LORD had dried up the waters of the Jordan before the Israelites . . . until they had crossed over their hearts melted and their spirits failed . . . for fear of the Israelites . . .
verses.literalPt: E SUCEDEU que, ouvindo todos os reis dos amorreus, que habitavam deste lado do Jordão, ao ocidente, e todos os reis dos cananeus, que estavam ao pé do mar, que o SENHOR tinha secado as águas do Jordão, de diante dos filhos de Israel, até que passassem, desfaleceu-se-lhes o coração, e não houve mais ânimo neles, por causa dos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: בָּעֵ֣ת הַהִ֗יא אָמַ֤ר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ עֲשֵׂ֥ה לְךָ֖ חַֽרְב֣וֹת צֻרִ֑ים וְשׁ֛וּב מֹ֥ל אֶת־ בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שֵׁנִֽית׃
verses.transliteration: bā·‘êṯ ha·hî ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’el- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ‘ă·śêh lə·ḵā ḥar·ḇō·wṯ ṣu·rîm wə·šūḇ mōl ’eṯ- bə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl šê·nîṯ
verses.literal: At that time the LORD said to Joshua Make flint knives and circumcise the sons of Israel once again . . .
verses.literalPt: Naquele tempo disse o SENHOR a Josué: Faze facas de pedra, e torna a circuncidar segunda vez aos filhos de Israel.

verses.original: וַיַּעַשׂ־ ל֥וֹ יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ חַֽרְב֣וֹת צֻרִ֑ים וַיָּ֙מָל֙ אֶת־ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֶל־ גִּבְעַ֖ת הָעֲרָלֽוֹת׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘aś- lōw yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ḥar·ḇō·wṯ ṣu·rîm way·yā·māl ’eṯ- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’el- giḇ·‘aṯ hā·‘ă·rā·lō·wṯ
verses.literal: So Joshua made flint knives and circumcised the sons of Israel at Gibeath-haaraloth . . .
verses.literalPt: Então Josué fez para si facas de pedra, e circuncidou aos filhos de Israel no monte dos prepúcios.

verses.original: וְזֶ֥ה הַדָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁר־ מָ֣ל יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ כָּל־ הָעָ֣ם הַיֹּצֵא֩ מִמִּצְרַ֨יִם הַזְּכָרִ֜ים כֹּ֣ל׀ אַנְשֵׁ֣י הַמִּלְחָמָ֗ה מֵ֤תוּ בַמִּדְבָּר֙ בַּדֶּ֔רֶךְ בְּצֵאתָ֖ם מִמִּצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·zeh had·dā·ḇār ’ă·šer- māl yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ kāl- hā·‘ām hay·yō·ṣê mim·miṣ·ra·yim haz·zə·ḵā·rîm kōl ’an·šê ham·mil·ḥā·māh mê·ṯū ḇam·miḏ·bār bad·de·reḵ bə·ṣê·ṯām mim·miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: Now this is why Joshua circumcised them All those who came out of Egypt all the men of war had died on the journey in the wilderness after they had left Egypt
verses.literalPt: E foi esta a causa por que Josué os circuncidou: todo o povo que tinha saído do Egito, os homens, todos os homens de guerra, já haviam morrido no deserto, pelo caminho, depois que saíram do Egito.

verses.original: כִּֽי־ מֻלִ֣ים הָי֔וּ כָּל־ הָעָ֖ם הַיֹּֽצְאִ֑ים וְכָל־ הָ֠עָם הַיִּלֹּדִ֨ים בַּמִּדְבָּ֥ר בַּדֶּ֛רֶךְ בְּצֵאתָ֥ם מִמִּצְרַ֖יִם לֹא־ מָֽלוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî- mu·lîm hā·yū kāl- hā·‘ām hay·yō·ṣə·’îm wə·ḵāl hā·‘ām hay·yil·lō·ḏîm bam·miḏ·bār bad·de·reḵ bə·ṣê·ṯām mim·miṣ·ra·yim lō- mā·lū
verses.literal: Though all . . . who had come out were circumcised none . . . of those born in the wilderness on the journey from Egypt had been circumcised
verses.literalPt: Porque todos os do povo que saíram estavam circuncidados, mas a nenhum dos que nasceram no deserto, pelo caminho, depois de terem saído do Egito, haviam circuncidado.

verses.original: כִּ֣י׀ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֗ה הָלְכ֣וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ בַּמִּדְבָּר֒ עַד־ תֹּ֨ם כָּל־ הַגּ֜וֹי אַנְשֵׁ֤י הַמִּלְחָמָה֙ הַיֹּצְאִ֣ים מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם אֲשֶׁ֥ר לֹֽא־ שָׁמְע֖וּ בְּק֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר נִשְׁבַּ֤ע יְהוָה֙ לָהֶ֔ם לְבִלְתִּ֞י הַרְאוֹתָ֣ם אֶת־ הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁר֩ נִשְׁבַּ֨ע יְהוָ֤ה לַֽאֲבוֹתָם֙ לָ֣תֶת לָ֔נוּ אֶ֛רֶץ זָבַ֥ת חָלָ֖ב וּדְבָֽשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’ar·bā·‘îm šā·nāh hā·lə·ḵū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl bam·miḏ·bār ‘aḏ- tōm kāl- hag·gō·w ’an·šê ham·mil·ḥā·māh hay·yō·ṣə·’îm mim·miṣ·ra·yim ’ă·šer lō- šā·mə·‘ū bə·qō·wl Yah·weh ’ă·šer niš·ba‘ Yah·weh lā·hem lə·ḇil·tî har·’ō·w·ṯām ’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ’ă·šer niš·ba‘ Yah·weh la·’ă·ḇō·w·ṯām lā·ṯeṯ lā·nū ’e·reṣ zā·ḇaṯ ḥā·lāḇ ū·ḏə·ḇāš
verses.literal: For the Israelites . . . had wandered in the wilderness forty years until all the nation’s men of war who had come out of Egypt had died since they did not obey . . . the LORD So the LORD vowed never to let them see the land He had sworn to their fathers to give us a land flowing with milk and honey
verses.literalPt: Porque quarenta anos andaram os filhos de Israel pelo deserto, até se acabar toda a nação, os homens de guerra, que saíram do Egito, e não obedeceram à voz do SENHOR; aos quais o SENHOR tinha jurado que lhes não havia de deixar ver a terra que o SENHOR jurara a seus pais dar-nos; terra que mana leite e mel.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ בְּנֵיהֶם֙ הֵקִ֣ים תַּחְתָּ֔ם אֹתָ֖ם מָ֣ל יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ כִּי־ עֲרֵלִ֣ים הָי֔וּ כִּ֛י לֹא־ מָ֥לוּ אוֹתָ֖ם בַּדָּֽרֶךְ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- bə·nê·hem hê·qîm taḥ·tām ’ō·ṯām māl yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ kî- ‘ă·rê·lîm hā·yū kî lō- mā·lū ’ō·w·ṯām bad·dā·reḵ
verses.literal: And He raised up their sons in their place and these were the ones Joshua circumcised Until this time they were . . . still uncircumcised since they had not been circumcised along the way
verses.literalPt: Porém em seu lugar pôs a seus filhos; a estes Josué circuncidou, porquanto estavam incircuncisos, porque os não circuncidaram no caminho.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֛י כַּאֲשֶׁר־ תַּ֥מּוּ כָל־ הַגּ֖וֹי לְהִמּ֑וֹל וַיֵּשְׁב֥וּ תַחְתָּ֛ם בַּֽמַּחֲנֶ֖ה עַ֥ד חֲיוֹתָֽם׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·hî ka·’ă·šer- tam·mū ḵāl hag·gō·w lə·him·mō·wl way·yê·šə·ḇū ṯaḥ·tām bam·ma·ḥă·neh ‘aḏ ḥă·yō·w·ṯām
verses.literal: And after . . . all the nation had been circumcised they stayed there in the camp until they were healed
verses.literalPt: E aconteceu que, acabando de circuncidar a toda a nação, ficaram no seu lugar no arraial, até que sararam.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֤אמֶר יְהוָה֙ אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ הַיּ֗וֹם גַּלּ֛וֹתִי אֶת־ חֶרְפַּ֥ת מִצְרַ֖יִם מֵעֲלֵיכֶ֑ם וַיִּקְרָ֞א שֵׁ֣ם הַמָּק֤וֹם הַהוּא֙ גִּלְגָּ֔ל עַ֖ד הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer Yah·weh ’el- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ hay·yō·wm gal·lō·w·ṯî ’eṯ- ḥer·paṯ miṣ·ra·yim mê·‘ă·lê·ḵem way·yiq·rā šêm ham·mā·qō·wm ha·hū gil·gāl ‘aḏ hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Joshua Today I have rolled away the reproach of Egypt from you So that place has been called . . . Gilgal to this day
verses.literalPt: Disse mais o SENHOR a Josué: Hoje retirei de sobre vós o opróbrio do Egito; por isso o nome daquele lugar se chamou Gilgal, até ao dia de hoje.

verses.original: וַיַּחֲנ֥וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל בַּגִּלְגָּ֑ל וַיַּעֲשׂ֣וּ אֶת־ הַפֶּ֡סַח בְּאַרְבָּעָה֩ עָשָׂ֨ר י֥וֹם לַחֹ֛דֶשׁ בָּעֶ֖רֶב בְּעַֽרְב֥וֹת יְרִיחֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·ḥă·nū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl bag·gil·gāl way·ya·‘ă·śū ’eṯ- hap·pe·saḥ bə·’ar·bā·‘āh ‘ā·śār yō·wm la·ḥō·ḏeš bā·‘e·reḇ bə·‘ar·ḇō·wṯ yə·rî·ḥōw
verses.literal: On the evening of the fourteenth . . . day of the month while the Israelites . . . were camped at Gilgal on the plains of Jericho they kept the Passover
verses.literalPt: Estando, pois, os filhos de Israel acampados em Gilgal, celebraram a páscoa no dia catorze do mês, à tarde, nas campinas de Jericó.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אכְל֜וּ מֵעֲב֥וּר הָאָ֛רֶץ מִמָּֽחֳרַ֥ת הַפֶּ֖סַח מַצּ֣וֹת וְקָל֑וּי בְּעֶ֖צֶם הַיּ֥וֹם הַזֶּֽה׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·ḵə·lū mê·‘ă·ḇūr hā·’ā·reṣ mim·mā·ḥo·raṯ hap·pe·saḥ maṣ·ṣō·wṯ wə·qā·lui bə·‘e·ṣem hay·yō·wm haz·zeh
verses.literal: The day after the Passover on that very day . . . they ate unleavened bread and roasted grain from the produce of the land
verses.literalPt: E, ao outro dia depois da páscoa, nesse mesmo dia, comeram, do fruto da terra, pães ázimos e espigas tostadas.

verses.original: וַיִּשְׁבֹּ֨ת הַמָּ֜ן מִֽמָּחֳרָ֗ת בְּאָכְלָם֙ מֵעֲב֣וּר הָאָ֔רֶץ וְלֹא־ הָ֥יָה ע֛וֹד לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל מָ֑ן וַיֹּאכְל֗וּ מִתְּבוּאַת֙ אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנַ֔עַן בַּשָּׁנָ֖ה הַהִֽיא׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yiš·bōṯ ham·mān mim·mā·ḥo·rāṯ bə·’ā·ḵə·lām mê·‘ă·ḇūr hā·’ā·reṣ wə·lō- hā·yāh ‘ō·wḏ liḇ·nê yiś·rā·’êl mān way·yō·ḵə·lū mit·tə·ḇū·’aṯ ’e·reṣ kə·na·‘an baš·šā·nāh ha·hî
verses.literal: And the day after they had eaten from the produce of the land the manna ceased There was no more manna for the Israelites . . . so that year they began to eat the crops of the land of Canaan
verses.literalPt: E cessou o maná no dia seguinte, depois que comeram do fruto da terra, e os filhos de Israel não tiveram mais maná; porém, no mesmo ano comeram dos frutos da terra de Canaã.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י בִּֽהְי֣וֹת יְהוֹשֻׁעַ֮ בִּירִיחוֹ֒ וַיִּשָּׂ֤א עֵינָיו֙ וַיַּ֔רְא וְהִנֵּה־ אִישׁ֙ עֹמֵ֣ד לְנֶגְדּ֔וֹ וְחַרְבּ֥וֹ שְׁלוּפָ֖ה בְּיָד֑וֹ וַיֵּ֨לֶךְ יְהוֹשֻׁ֤עַ אֵלָיו֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ הֲלָ֥נוּ אַתָּ֖ה אִם־ לְצָרֵֽינוּ׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî bih·yō·wṯ yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bî·rî·ḥōw way·yiś·śā ‘ê·nāw way·yar wə·hin·nêh- ’îš ‘ō·mêḏ lə·neḡ·dōw wə·ḥar·bōw šə·lū·p̄āh bə·yā·ḏōw way·yê·leḵ yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’ê·lāw way·yō·mer lōw hă·lā·nū ’at·tāh ’im- lə·ṣā·rê·nū
verses.literal: Now when Joshua was . . . near Jericho he looked up . . . and saw . . . a man standing in front of him with a drawn sword in His hand Joshua approached Him and asked Are You for us or for our enemies
verses.literalPt: E sucedeu que, estando Josué perto de Jericó, levantou os seus olhos e olhou; e eis que se pôs em pé diante dele um homem que tinha na mão uma espada nua; e chegou-se Josué a ele, e disse-lhe: És tu dos nossos, ou dos nossos inimigos?

verses.original: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר׀ לֹ֗א כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י שַׂר־ צְבָֽא־ יְהוָ֖ה עַתָּ֣ה בָ֑אתִי וַיִּפֹּל֩ יְהוֹשֻׁ֨עַ אֶל־ פָּנָ֥יו אַ֙רְצָה֙ וַיִּשְׁתָּ֔חוּ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ מָ֥ה אֲדֹנִ֖י מְדַבֵּ֥ר אֶל־ עַבְדּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer lō kî ’ă·nî śar- ṣə·ḇā- Yah·weh ‘at·tāh ḇā·ṯî way·yip·pōl yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’el- pā·nāw ’ar·ṣāh way·yiš·tā·ḥū way·yō·mer lōw māh ’ă·ḏō·nî mə·ḏab·bêr ’el- ‘aḇ·dōw
verses.literal: Neither . . . He replied I have now come as Commander of the LORD’s army Then Joshua fell facedown . . . . . . in reverence and asked Him What does my Lord have to say to His servant
verses.literalPt: E disse ele: Não, mas venho agora como príncipe do exército do SENHOR. Então Josué se prostrou com o seu rosto em terra e o adorou, e disse-lhe: Que diz meu senhor ao seu servo?

verses.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ שַׂר־ צְבָ֨א יְהוָ֜ה אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֗עַ שַׁל־ נַֽעַלְךָ֙ מֵעַ֣ל רַגְלֶ֔ךָ כִּ֣י הַמָּק֗וֹם אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתָּ֛ה עֹמֵ֥ד עָלָ֖יו קֹ֣דֶשׁ ה֑וּא וַיַּ֥עַשׂ יְהוֹשֻׁ֖עַ כֵּֽן׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer śar- ṣə·ḇā Yah·weh ’el- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ šal- na·‘al·ḵā mê·‘al raḡ·le·ḵā kî ham·mā·qō·wm ’ă·šer ’at·tāh ‘ō·mêḏ ‘ā·lāw qō·ḏeš hū way·ya·‘aś yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ kên
verses.literal: The Commander of the LORD’s army replied - Take off your sandals - for the place where you are standing . . . is holy . . . And Joshua did so
verses.literalPt: Então disse o príncipe do exército do SENHOR a Josué: Descalça os sapatos de teus pés, porque o lugar em que estás é santo. E fez Josué assim.
